title: Chapter 263 Upgrading The Town
content:
Chapter 263 Upgrading The Town

After returning to the territory, Wang Shuo took Chef Zhang and Zhang Yang to visit his territory.

"Zhang Yang, have you ever obtained materials like Yinchen Wood?"

Zhang Yang thought about it and shook his head and said, "No, what is the use of this Yinchen Wood?"

Wang Shuo did not hide it and told him about the dead spirit beads.

And offered to give him 100 beads.

But Zhang Yang refused.

It's not that he didn't want it, but 100 beads can't solve the problem at all.

"Wang Shuo, let's trade normally. I'll buy 500 first."

Wang Shuo sold it to Zhang Yang at the price of 5 energy crystals per piece.

Zhang Yang didn't stay in Wana Village for long. After all, he was also a family and a business. He soon returned to his Jiuyang Village.

Wang Shuo accompanied Chef Zhang again and chose a very popular location in the newly built city wall.

"Here!"

Chef Zhang nodded with satisfaction.

"Okay, I will definitely build you a grand restaurant." Wang Shuo smiled and nodded, "Duan Wenxi, this matter is your personal responsibility, and you must decorate it well."

"Don't worry, Boss."

...

At the old site of Nanshanji, there were broken walls and ruins in front of her.

Dongfang Ling was stunned. Halfway through, she had learned that Wang Shuo had won the battle of Nanshanji.

But she was almost there, and she still wanted to come and take a look.

After entering and walking around, she found out that Wang Shuo had returned to Wana Village.

Dongfang Ling glanced in the direction of Wana Village, feeling lost.

"Miss, let's go back! The next time we meet, we may be enemies instead of friends!"

Fang Kai's voice sounded out of place.

Dongfang Ling has been managing Wu'an Village for some time. The reason why Wu'an Village has developed so rapidly is closely related to her.

The growth of territory and population is based on continuous foreign wars.

She also deeply experienced the cruel side of this world.

After standing there for a long time, she turned away without saying a word.

Fang Kai smiled and turned to his men and said, "Go back to the territory!"

Wana Village.

Wang Shuo had several things to do.

He first came to the core of the territory and saw that the mysterious pattern under the light curtain was inlaid with more and more things.

He felt a full sense of accomplishment.

[Detected that the player has the heart of the town. Do you want to use it? ]

"Yes."

In an instant, the heart of the town flew into the light curtain, and the original village construction order and the heart of the town merged together.

Just like when Nanshanji was breached, the village construction order and the heart of the town were separated.

Originally, the level of Wana Village's village construction order was gold, but because of the system reward, the level was increased by 1 level to "rare level".

[Rare village construction order: the speed of territory construction increased by 10%, the speed of territory soldier training increased by 20%, the growth cycle of territory crops shortened by 15%, and the speed of upgrading the life skills of the territory residents increased by 15%. ]

Wang Shuo immediately checked the attributes of the territory.

[Territory attributes]

[Territory: Wana Town (primary town)]

[Lord: Wang Shuo]

[Territory attributes: popular support, outstanding people and beautiful scenery]

[Territory reputation: 800 (famous for a hundred miles)]

[Area: 5 kilometers in radius]

[Population: 24,000]

[Popularity: 82 (average)]

[Buildings: ...]

[Military: ...]

[Auspicious beast in the territory: Koi (juvenile stage)]

...

[Upgrade conditions: To upgrade to a second-level town, you need a population of 50,000, a popular sentiment of 85, a silver energy converter, and buildings: Lord's mansion, residential houses, teleportation array, ...]

Wang Shuo found that the conditions for upgrading a second-level town were still quite complicated, and the population alone required 50,000.

In addition, a large number of buildings were required. It seemed that it would take some time before it could be upgraded.
